rulings.reason: The criterion's object is the mathematics itself -- whether symbols are standard and used consistently -- which is domain craft, not typography: reusing or improvising notation is a genuine defect in a mathematical argument. The 'well-formatted' clause adds a thin format component, but a judge scoring this instruction would mostly be reporting on the discipline of the math being presented.

A judge scoring this instruction counts direct-address moves at the end of the post, which is a rhetorical form detectable without reading any of the mathematics. The criterion also conflates comprehension checks with soliciting help for one's own broken post, so there is no single upstream cause that plausibly generates genuine answer quality.

The 5 and 0 anchors define the scale purely by how much second-person voice runs through the text, so a judge applying it produces a register measurement even though the 10 anchor bundles in real responsiveness (adopting the asker's framing, anticipating their next confusion). Mixed because that bundled tailoring is a plausible upstream cause of genuinely more useful answers.
